## About Me

Hello! My name is Zhiyue Liu. I am currently pursuing a master's degree in Biostatistics at Columbia University, focusing on the Data Science track.

I graduated from the University of California, Davis, with a bachelor's degree in Applied Statistics.

I have gained professional experience through management consulting internships at PwC and IQVIA.

I am interested in data science, statistical analysis, and management consulting. I enjoy using data to understand problems and support decision-making.

This website provides an overview of my academic background and professional experience.
